title: Reboot Talks
text: Get ready for a dynamic lineup of tech talks that spark ideas and challenge perspectives. From industry insights to future-forward thinking, these sessions are designed to energise and educate.

title: Reboot Works
text: Roll up your sleeves and dive into our hands-on workshops! Whether you're a curious beginner or a seasoned techie, you'll leave with new skills and fresh ideas.

title: Wellbeing Room
text: Recharge your mind and body in our dedicated Wellbeing Room. Join calming sessions in the boardroom to reset, refocus, and reconnect with yourself.

title: Speed Mentoring
text: Fast-track your growth with our Speed Mentoring sessions. Meet experienced mentors, ask your burning questions, and walk away with actionable advice—all in a matter of minutes.​

title: Hackathon
text: 156 brilliant minds. 2 bold business challenges. Countless creative solutions. Watch as teams compete for glory and prizes in our high-energy Hackathon showdown.
